The Cedarville University School of Pharmacy seeks full-time Assistant, Associate, or Full Professor candidates in the Department of Pharmacy Practice. Rank is commensurate with experience. Eligibility for a tenure or clinical track appointment will be determined based on institutional needs and candidate qualifications at the time of hire. Candidates should have an interest and expertise in the disciplines of pharmacotherapy and/or social administrative sciences. Other areas of interest and expertise will be considered based on departmental needs. Primary responsibilities include didactic and experiential teaching, clinical and instructional scholarship, and service to the department, school, university, and the profession. Didactic teaching responsibility and course coordination will be assigned based upon the candidates' expertise and departmental needs. The faculty member will also maintain a clinical practice with primary responsibilities including managing clinical services, supervising Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) students completing experiential rotations and/or pharmacy residents, and developing and executing novel clinical programs. Clinical practice opportunities are available in infectious diseases, ambulatory care, and internal medicine.
